fact_check_rounds.label: Round 1: the 30 top-ranked plants profiled (three checkers, one per profiler batch, on the unmerged profiler files)
Round 2: the last 10 profiling slots, ranked after closure 2 (one checker on the unmerged profiler file)
Round 3: line check of every High and Medium plant's opening line and bottleneck guess, by a checker who did not write them
Cross-vertical checks (state air permits, job-board dates, OSHA headcounts, profiles of OSHA top-40 entrants): rows for this vertical's plants
Base-record sample: 25 base and 8 excluded records drawn with a fixed seed after closure 2 and both miss verifications (reported separately; not a profile round)

miss_rate.note: R2 blind audit after closure 2: 8 verified misses / (64 included plants the auditors found + 8). Auditors: local and geography sources (C) and recall filings, defense awards, show exhibitors and fleet case studies (D); neither reached a dry point. Six of the 8 misses rest on auditor rows marked plant-confirmed. Against the list before closure 2: 9/72 = 12.5%. Upper bound counting the 7 not-confirmed candidates and SAF-Holland Dumas (pulled back to a lead under T16): 16/80 = 20.0%. R1 (job postings and brand/registry methods) measured 24.3%, restated to 22.5% after rulings T16-T17 were applied to found and missed plants alike.
history: 22.5% (R1 after rulings T16-T17, applied both ways)

known_limits: Neither blind audit reached a dry point in either round; the R2 upper bound is 20.0%.
Rulings T16-T21 were written after the R1 candidate names were known; they were applied to found and missed plants alike and logged before closure 2 and the R2 audit.

Base records rest partly on registry footing (T15: an OSHA 336212 record plus an EPA name, prospect low confidence; T18: a government or association record naming the trailer type). Component, tank-trailer, stale and unshown-product sites (about 210 distinct lead rows) stay in the screen files, not on the map.
Hardin Lacon (multi-vertical) was fact-checked in the data-center rounds, not in a trailers round.
osha.gov is blocked from this session: OSHA headcounts rest on the 2025 national file under the gate rule; EPA FRS timed out for much of the day (ECHO used instead).
ADP Workforce Now job boards return about 20 requisitions per call; five boards were re-read with paging, the others were not, so a few postings may be missing from base records.
